integrity: Proof is analytic; numerical checks are corroborative, not a universal or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only unit regular base with parallel displaced apices aligned to a base vertex, with 0<s<cos(pi/n), h>0, and Haar-uniform central planes. Full historical priority not independently established; Voss 1982 and Sukiasyan 1982 inaccessible in full.
title: Parity and high-order shear asymmetry in random central sections of skew bipyramids
